title: Context Where It Counts | Morgan Stanley
description: December 14, 2017 - Blair Livingston, Street Contxt founder and CEO, talks about improving the client experience by delivering the right information to the right person at the right time. https://www.morganstanley.com/articles/fintech-summit-2017/

asr.full_text: StreetContext basically helps brokages more intelligently distribute content to clients and really understand what that engagement looks like and use that engagement data to drive intelligent conversations with their clients basically making sure they call the right person at the right time. My name's Blair Lemingston. I'm the founder and CEO of StreetContext and we provide funds with best-in-class knowledge management tools and access to a global pool of content. We think about every consumer along the process of context, and we provide funds with best in class knowledge management tools and access to a global pool of content. We think about every consumer along the process, which means the salesperson who's typing up the note, the trader or research analyst who's sending it out, the management team who's looking at the engagement and the metrics, and of course the end recipient. We have the opportunity to present to the Morgan Stanley team. It's great to see an organization bring your leaders from across the business to engage with fintech companies leaders from across the business to engage with FinTech companies ranging from very small to medium to large. To really see what they can learn from each other and how we can work together to really drive end-client experience and make it better for our mutual clients.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents an institutional fintech profile in which StreetContext's founder discusses software for distributing financial-industry content, measuring engagement, and improving client communications. The Morgan Stanley venue, StreetContext-branded laptop, conference audience, and closing Morgan Stanley screen are consistent with a recorded corporate event or interview. The discussion does not describe an investment-return promise, transaction request, credential request, or other supported mechanism directed at the audience.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an operational and business-technology discussion describing tools that distribute financial-industry content, provide access to content, and measure client engagement.
